title: TC008-Search term change updates from no-results back to results
description: Verifies that after reaching a no-results state, updating the search term can restore visible results in the grid.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:3000
        await page.goto("http://localhost:3000", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Click the INVENTARIO link (index 101) to navigate to the /inventario page and reveal the search input.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/header/div/nav/a[2]').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        
        # -> Type 'zzzz-no-existe-12345' into the search input (index 769) and wait for results to update.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Input text
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/main/div/div[2]/div/aside/div[1]/div/input').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.fill('zzzz-no-existe-12345')
        
        # -> Verify that the text 'No se encontraron' (no-results message) is visible on the page, then type 'casa' into the search input to restore results.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Input text
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/main/div/div[2]/div/aside/div[1]/div/input').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.fill('casa')
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Verify that the no-results message "No se encontraron" is present after searching a non-existent term
        # The page does not contain any element with that text in the available elements list — report and stop the test.
        raise AssertionError("Expected text 'No se encontraron' not found on the page after searching 'zzzz-no-existe-12345'. Feature appears to be missing; marking the task done.")
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())
